jobs.title: Capital Markets - Research Associate
jobs.description:
About LionTree

LionTree is a differentiated global investment and merchant banking firm, with a focus on media, technology and telecommunications. Formed in 2012, LionTree combines an entrepreneurial approach with deep sector expertise to identify and execute on the best solutions across geographies, transaction types and client initiatives. A trusted strategic partner, we leverage unique insights and relationships to connect clients with the tailored ideas, opportunities and resources that drive results. We have three business segments at the firm – Advisory, Public & Capital Markets, and Asset Management.  With offices in New York, San Francisco, and London, LionTree serves clients across the globe.

Job Summary:

We are seeking an individual to join our Public & Capital Markets division, which has a multifaceted mandate across thematic research/insights, institutional investor coverage, and IPO advisory.

Duties and Responsibilities:

- A primary responsibility will be to create editorial content that covers a wide range of topics in the media, technology, and digital economy sectors. This includes:

- Assisting in the preparation of a weekly TMT thematic report which is distributed to the firm’s top clients (public and private company executives, private equity and venture capital investors, and large institutional investors)

- Assist in other monthly and quarterly thematic content that we create and distribute

- Stay on top of key industry and sector trends

- Another primary responsibility is to help plan, support, and execute our company and sector discussions and bus tours with our institutional investor clients

- Other responsibilities include:

- Help maintain our processes, systems, and databases

- Support our IPO advisory efforts

- Interact and engage with clients, internal constituents, and senior management teams

- Participate in cross-product collaboration with banking advisory and merchant banking teams

Requirements:

- Must enjoy writing and researching and must also have strong, clear and concise written and oral communication skills

- Must have the ability to distill large amounts of information succinctly and be able to cut through the noise

- Must have a high level of attention to detail

- Must be able to meet deadlines (we publish on Friday nights)

- Must be entrepreneurial, a self-starter, and have a strong work ethic

- Must have a level of knowledge and understanding of accounting principles and the public markets

- Must have the ability to work effectively in a small team environment and across all organizational levels, where flexibility, collaboration, and adaptability are important

Experience & Qualifications:

- Must have a minimum of a bachelor's degree in a related field

- 2+ years of Sell-Side / Buy-Side Equity Research, financial journalism, or corporate role in the TMT sector

- Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including high level of proficiency in modeling

- Advanced Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint) skills

- General technology skills

Not required but a plus:

- Buyside relationships with TMT investors & experience with investing

- Experience using FactSet and Bloomberg, and other data aggregation programs

jobs.title: LionTree - 2028 US Advisory Summer Analyst - NY
jobs.description:
About LionTree :

LionTree is a differentiated global investment and merchant banking firm focused on companies in the technology, media, telecom and consumer-related industries. LionTree was founded in 2012 and has offices in New York, San Francisco, and London to serve a global client base. LionTree has built a successful track record by leveraging its unique insights and relationships to assist clients across its integrated product set: Investment Banking Advisory, Public Markets / IPO Advisory and Merchant Banking Investments.

Since our formation, LionTree has advised on over $850bn of deal volume across over 300+ transactions. LionTree represents clients ranging from large-cap leaders to emerging growth companies. Select notable transactions include: advising Naver on its $1.2bn acquisition of Poshmark, Take-Two Interactive on its $12.7bn acquisition of Zynga, The Athletic on its sale to the New York Times, MGM Studios on its $8.5bn sale to Amazon, WarnerMedia (AT&T) and Discovery’s ~$140bn merger, Viacom on its $47bn merger with CBS, Pandora on its $3.5bn sale to SiriusXM, and Charter on its $78.7bn acquisition of Time Warner Cable.

Program Description:

LionTree offers a 11-week summer analyst program for rising seniors. As a summer analyst, you will be fully immersed in the day-to-day activities of our New York office. The program is designed to provide a realistic view of our full-time Investment Banking Analyst Program. Upon completion of the program, Summer Analysts have the opportunity to receive full-time Analyst offers for a post-graduation start date.

As a summer analyst, you will:

- Obtain a strong foundation in financial analysis through training from LionTree professionals as well as third-party providers

- Have the opportunity to work on live client assignments alongside LionTree deal teams

- Present financial and strategic analysis to the firm’s leadership during your final project

- Attend orientation and firm events where you will learn about LionTree and the industry while meeting members of the firm globally

- Gain access to an invaluable peer network of interns, as well as senior firm leaders and other peers through an assigned mentorship team
